content.json:
## Incidents by organization
Start with the time range; then optionally narrow down by **ManagingOrganizationId** and **OrganizationId**. `All` = no filter.

parameters.name: ManagingOrganizationId
parameters.label: ManagingOrganizationId
parameters.description: All = every Managing Org. '(no Managing Org)' = only records without this ID.
parameters.query:
union exceptions, requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where not(itemType == "exception" and client_Type == "Browser")
| where operation_Name !has "getConnectionInfo"
// Noise: HEAD/OPTIONS probes, static files and bot/scanner paths (.php, .png, ...)
| where not(operation_Name startswith "HEAD " or operation_Name startswith "OPTIONS ")
| where not(operation_Name matches regex @"(?i)\.(php\d?|aspx?|jsp|cgi|env|git|bak|sql|zip|png|jpe?g|gif|svg|ico|webp|css|js|map|txt|xml|woff2?|ttf|eot|html?)(/|$)")
| where tostring(customDimensions) contains "organizationid"
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.ManagingOrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)),
         OrgId   = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.OrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd))
| where isnotempty(MgOrgId)
| summarize n = sum(itemCount) by MgOrgId
| order by n desc
| project value = MgOrgId, label = MgOrgId
| union (print value = "__none__", label = "(no Managing Org)")

parameters.name: OrganizationId
parameters.label: OrganizationId
parameters.description: Lists the organizations of the selected Managing Org (or all of them when set to All).
parameters.query:
let MgOrg = "{ManagingOrganizationId}";
let AllVals = dynamic(["", "*", "value::all"]);
union exceptions, requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where not(itemType == "exception" and client_Type == "Browser")
| where operation_Name !has "getConnectionInfo"
// Noise: HEAD/OPTIONS probes, static files and bot/scanner paths (.php, .png, ...)
| where not(operation_Name startswith "HEAD " or operation_Name startswith "OPTIONS ")
| where not(operation_Name matches regex @"(?i)\.(php\d?|aspx?|jsp|cgi|env|git|bak|sql|zip|png|jpe?g|gif|svg|ico|webp|css|js|map|txt|xml|woff2?|ttf|eot|html?)(/|$)")
| where tostring(customDimensions) contains "organizationid"
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.ManagingOrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)),
         OrgId   = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.OrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd))
| where MgOrg in (AllVals) or (MgOrg == "__none__" and isempty(MgOrgId)) or MgOrgId == MgOrg
| where isnotempty(OrgId)
| summarize n = sum(itemCount), Mg = take_anyif(MgOrgId, isnotempty(MgOrgId)) by OrgId
| order by n desc
| project value = OrgId, label = strcat(OrgId, "  ·  ", iff(isempty(Mg), "no Managing Org", strcat("MgOrg ", Mg)))

content.query:
let MgOrg = "{ManagingOrganizationId}";
let Org = "{OrganizationId}";
let AllVals = dynamic(["", "*", "value::all"]);
let F = exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where client_Type != "Browser"
// Known noise: ignore getConnectionInfo entirely
| where operation_Name !has "getConnectionInfo"
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.ManagingOrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)),
         OrgId   = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.OrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd))
| where MgOrg in (AllVals) or (MgOrg == "__none__" and isempty(MgOrgId)) or MgOrgId == MgOrg
| where Org in (AllVals) or OrgId == Org;
F
| summarize Exceptions = sum(itemCount),
            MgOrgs = dcountif(MgOrgId, isnotempty(MgOrgId)),
            Orgs = dcountif(OrgId, isnotempty(OrgId)),
            NoId = sumif(itemCount, isempty(MgOrgId) and isempty(OrgId))
| project Data = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Exceptions", "Value", Exceptions),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Affected Managing Orgs", "Value", MgOrgs),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Affected organizations", "Value", Orgs),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Without ID", "Value", NoId))
| mv-expand Data
| project Metric = tostring(Data.Metric), Value = tolong(Data.Value)
content.title: Summary

### Selected exception
All fields of the selected row, plus every request, dependency, exception and trace that belongs to the same operation.

content.query:
let row = exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where itemId == "{SelectedExceptionId}"
| take 1;
let general = row
| project-away customDimensions, customMeasurements, details
| extend Bag = pack_all()
| mv-expand Field = bag_keys(Bag) to typeof(string)
| project Section = "General", Field, Value = tostring(Bag[Field]), SortKey = 1;
let custom = row
| mv-expand Field = bag_keys(customDimensions) to typeof(string)
| project Section = "Custom properties", Field, Value = tostring(customDimensions[Field]), SortKey = 2;
union general, custom
| where isnotempty(Value)
| order by SortKey asc, Field asc
| project-away SortKey
content.title: All fields of the selected exception

items.name: All fields of the selected exception

content.query:
let row = exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where itemId == "{SelectedExceptionId}"
| take 1;
row
| mv-expand d = details
| mv-expand f = d.parsedStack
| project Exception = tostring(d.type), Message = tostring(d.message),
          Level = toint(f.level), Method = tostring(f.method),
          Assembly = tostring(f.assembly), File = tostring(f.fileName), Line = toint(f.line)
content.title: Stack trace

content.query:
union requests, dependencies, exceptions, traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where operation_Id == "{SelectedExceptionOpId}"
| extend Name = case(
    itemType == "request",    name,
    itemType == "dependency", strcat(type, " · ", target, " · ", name),
    itemType == "exception",  strcat(type, ": ", outerMessage),
    itemType == "trace",      message,
    ""),
  Result = case(
    itemType in ("request", "dependency"), strcat(resultCode, iff(success == false, " (failed)", "")),
    itemType in ("trace", "exception"),    strcat("severity ", tostring(severityLevel)),
    "")
| project timestamp, Type = itemType, Name, Result, DurationMs = round(duration, 0), itemId
| order by timestamp asc
| take 500
content.title: Everything in the same operation

content.query:
let MgOrg = "{ManagingOrganizationId}";
let Org = "{OrganizationId}";
let AllVals = dynamic(["", "*", "value::all"]);
let F = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
// Noise: HEAD/OPTIONS probes, static files and bot/scanner paths (.php, .png, ...)
| where not(name startswith "HEAD " or name startswith "OPTIONS ")
| where not(name matches regex @"(?i)\.(php\d?|aspx?|jsp|cgi|env|git|bak|sql|zip|png|jpe?g|gif|svg|ico|webp|css|js|map|txt|xml|woff2?|ttf|eot|html?)(/|$)")
// Known noise: ignore getConnectionInfo entirely
| where operation_Name !has "getConnectionInfo"
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.ManagingOrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)),
         OrgId   = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.OrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd))
| where MgOrg in (AllVals) or (MgOrg == "__none__" and isempty(MgOrgId)) or MgOrgId == MgOrg
| where Org in (AllVals) or OrgId == Org;
F
| summarize Requests = sum(itemCount),
            Failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false),
            P95 = percentile(duration, 95)
| extend FailurePct = round(100.0 * Failed / Requests, 1)
| project Data = pack_array(
    bag_pack("Metric", "Requests", "Value", Requests),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Failed requests", "Value", Failed),
    bag_pack("Metric", "Failure rate %", "Value", FailurePct),
    bag_pack("Metric", "P95 duration (ms)", "Value", round(P95, 0)))
| mv-expand Data
| project Metric = tostring(Data.Metric), Value = todouble(Data.Value)

content.query:
let MgOrg = "{ManagingOrganizationId}";
let Org = "{OrganizationId}";
let AllVals = dynamic(["", "*", "value::all"]);
let F = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
// Noise: HEAD/OPTIONS probes, static files and bot/scanner paths (.php, .png, ...)
| where not(name startswith "HEAD " or name startswith "OPTIONS ")
| where not(name matches regex @"(?i)\.(php\d?|aspx?|jsp|cgi|env|git|bak|sql|zip|png|jpe?g|gif|svg|ico|webp|css|js|map|txt|xml|woff2?|ttf|eot|html?)(/|$)")
// Known noise: ignore getConnectionInfo entirely
| where operation_Name !has "getConnectionInfo"
| extend cd = tostring(customDimensions)
| extend MgOrgId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.ManagingOrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.managingOrganizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd)),
         OrgId   = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.OrganizationId),
                           extract(@'(?i)"QueryParam\.organizationId":"([^"]*)"', 1, cd))
| where MgOrg in (AllVals) or (MgOrg == "__none__" and isempty(MgOrgId)) or MgOrgId == MgOrg
| where Org in (AllVals) or OrgId == Org;
F
| extend RawId = iff(MgOrg in (AllVals), MgOrgId, OrgId)
| extend Level = iff(MgOrg in (AllVals), "Managing Org", "Organization")
| summarize Requests = sum(itemCount),
            Failed = sumif(itemCount, success == false),
            P95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0)
          by Level, Id = iff(isempty(RawId), "(no ID)", RawId)
| extend FailurePct = round(100.0 * Failed / Requests, 1)
| order by Failed desc, Requests desc
content.title: Breakdown (Managing Org → Organization)
